cards.intuition: A matrix reserves a cell for every possible pair; a list stores only actual neighbors. Sparse retrieval graphs need the latter.
cards.formula: matrix space O(V²); adjacency-list space O(V+E)
cards.topic: Graph Representations: Adjacency Lists in Practice

cards.intuition: One offsets array marks each vertex's slice inside a flat neighbor-ID array. Contiguous integers replace millions of object pointers.
cards.topic: Graph Representations: Adjacency Lists in Practice

cards.intuition: Extra neighbors create more escape routes but consume adjacency memory and distance work on every expansion. Too few edges can isolate regions.
cards.formula: higher degree → more connectivity + more per-visit work
cards.topic: Graph Representations: Adjacency Lists in Practice

cards.intuition: Start somewhere, compare neighbors to the query, and walk to the best improving neighbor until no local step helps.
cards.formula: move c → argmin neighbor d(q,x) only if distance improves

cards.intuition: Avoid scoring all n vectors by touching only neighbors of visited vertices. The graph wins when that explored set stays small.
cards.formula: rough distance work O(vMd) versus exact scan O(nd)

cards.intuition: Keep a queue of promising alternatives rather than betting everything on one path. More expansion spends latency to recover recall.
cards.formula: candidate breadth controls the latency-recall frontier

cards.intuition: The current vertex beats every immediate neighbor but not the whole corpus. A route to the true answer may require temporarily moving farther away.
cards.formula: local: d(c,q) ≤ d(u,q) for every stored neighbor u; global may be better
cards.topic: Local Minima in Greedy Search and Why Layered Graphs Help

cards.intuition: Use sparse long-range links like highways to reach the right region, then descend to dense local streets for precise refinement.
cards.formula: coarse upper routing → descend → fine base-layer search
cards.topic: Local Minima in Greedy Search and Why Layered Graphs Help

cards.intuition: Poor bridges, weak base connectivity, or a small search budget can still miss. Measure recall against exact neighbors rather than assuming hierarchy guarantees correctness.
cards.formula: recall depends on construction + connectivity + search breadth
cards.topic: Local Minima in Greedy Search and Why Layered Graphs Help

cards.intuition: Trace whether the failure was unreachable connectivity, a local basin, exhausted budget, or distorted distance. Each mechanism needs a different repair.
cards.topic: Local Minima in Greedy Search and Why Layered Graphs Help
